messages: I ran into #p100# the fisherman again in #m10000000#. This time, he wants to get his wife #t4031043#s for her birthday and asked me to get #b20 #t4031043#s#k for him. Apparently, the scent of #t4031043#s lasts for over 500 years... #p100# told me that they can be found in the same place as last time, the #p609#. Man... Do I HAVE to go in there AGAIN??

I got #p100# all #b20 #t4031043#s#k. They do have a nice scent, but 20 of them? Makes my head spin... As a sign of appreciation, #p100# gave me a nice glove he found inside the ship. I mean, it looks like someone accidentally left their glove there... Is he allowed to give it to me like that? What if I wear it around town and run into its actual owner??
name: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Present
